config.description: GET /v2/stocks/bars with 100 symbols per request, timeframe=1Day, adjustment=all, feed=sip, limit=10000, page_token pagination. Universe (11611 symbols): the original S&P 500/400 + 67 ETF list first, then every other non-test common/ordinary/ADR equity and ETF in the Nasdaq Trader nasdaqlisted/otherlisted snapshot of 2026-09-15 (warrants, rights, units, preferreds and notes excluded), equities before ETFs so a budget stop truncates the ETF tail. 200 requests/minute plan limit.
